people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Beth-haccherem
people.line: Town in Judah, possibly fortified, mentioned by Jeremiah.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Tekoa
people.line: Town in Judah, home of the prophet Amos

translations.web: “Flee for safety, you children of Benjamin, out of the middle of Jerusalem! Blow the trumpet in Tekoa and raise up a signal on Beth Haccherem, for evil looks out from the north with a great destruction.
translations.bsb: “Run for cover, O sons of Benjamin; flee from Jerusalem! Sound the ram’s horn in Tekoa; send up a signal over Beth-haccherem, for disaster looms from the north, even great destruction.
translations.kjv: O ye children of Benjamin, gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and set up a sign of fire in Bethhaccerem: for evil appeareth out of the north, and great destruction.
translations.asv: Flee for safety, ye children of Benjamin, out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and raise up a signal on Beth-haccherem; for evil looketh forth from the north, and a great destruction.
